svg.text: Throughput, higher is better: requests per second (req/s), megabytes per second (MB/s) for 1 GB artifacts

svg.text: Every open-source Nx cache server with a published image, in containers on one Apple M4 Pro. 32 connections, 1 000 requests per phase (400 at 4 MB; 4 requests on 2 connections at 1 GB).

svg.text: In each panel every bar starts at 0 on one linear scale: twice the length is twice the throughput. Full tables and method: bench/RESULTS.md
